description: Claims and critiques about climate systems, forcing, projections, and mitigation/adaptation measures — distinguishing observation from model output, and disclosing funding, as first-class epistemic norms rather than assumed background.

critique_species.name: MethodologicalCritique
required_evidence: Description of the alternative method, and why it's more appropriate than the one being critiqued

critique_species.name: ModelUncertaintyCritique
required_evidence: The confidence interval, ensemble spread, or projection range being disputed

critique_species.name: StatisticalCritique
required_evidence: A reanalysis, or a citation of the statistical methodology being applied instead

critique_species.name: FundingBiasCritique
required_evidence: The documented funding source creating the alleged bias
